primary_criteria: held-out classifier-based target agreement (validation signal, not human GT)
rule: Exclude models that fail quality on genuine target-level cognitive transformation.
Among acceptable models, prefer the smaller/faster model if quality is practically comparable.
Select 1.5B only if it provides a substantial quality advantage AND satisfies CPU/offline memory constraints.
Do not select 1.5B because it is larger or 0.5B because it is lighter.
quantization_control: Compare GGUF models only under the same quantization regime (Q4_K_M vs Q4_K_M).
baselines: production GGUF if it is Qwen2.5-1.5B, not overwritten
